subject: stadium crowd
title: The 5 Biggest Stadiums on Earth, Ranked (#1 Isn't for Football)

scenes.text: The biggest stadium on Earth wasn't built for football.
Number five: Ohio Stadium in Columbus. About 102,780 seats.
scenes.label: Ohio Stadium · 102,780

scenes.text: Number four: Beaver Stadium at Penn State. Around 106,000 fans, packed in white.
scenes.label: Beaver Stadium · ~106,000

scenes.text: Number three: Michigan Stadium, nicknamed the Big House. 107,601 seats.
scenes.label: Michigan Stadium · 107,601

scenes.text: Number two: the May Day Stadium in Pyongyang. North Korea claims 150,000, but counts suggest about 114,000.
scenes.label: May Day Stadium · ~114,000

scenes.text: Number one: the Narendra Modi Stadium in India, built for cricket. About 132,000 seats.
scenes.label: Narendra Modi · ~132,000

description:
The five biggest stadiums by seating capacity: Ohio Stadium (102,780), Beaver Stadium (about 106,000 during renovation), Michigan Stadium (107,601), Pyongyang's Rungrado 1st of May Stadium (150,000 claimed, about 114,000 counted after its 2014 renovation) and the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad (about 132,000).
Which one would you most like to watch a game in?
first_comment: Which stadium would you put at number one, and what should we rank next?
